candidates.description: This vector represents Japanese phonetic suffixes, syllable endings, and name components.
This vector activates for cognitive and perceptual verbs relating to acquiring knowledge, beliefs, or experiences.
This feature vector represents categories, classifications, and formal variations of things.
This feature represents the concepts of education, instruction, and the acquisition or imparting of knowledge and skills.
These tokens represent modal and frequency adverbs that qualify the certainty, scope, or typicality of statements.
This vector represents handheld or ranged combat weapons, along with some phonetically or orthographically similar words.
This vector represents foundational concepts, methods, and principles underlying various disciplines or practices.
This vector activates for indefinite quantifiers and determiners expressing non-specific amounts or variety.
This vector represents adverbs, pronouns, and adjectives related to externality, formality, and alternative entities.
This vector activates on adverbs and derived forms relating to origins, initial states, or historical beginnings.
